universe.meaning: the bioactive-molecule universe is the ChEMBL total; the catalogue enumerates only compounds with a clinical-phase statement, a probe flag, or a source row; the rest is counted here and not listed
universe.meaning_of_the_previous: evidence of access in at least one US listing on a date, scoped per entry; not approval, appropriateness or safety, and not access for a given person or country

merge_report.rule: entries are never merged on name; evidence from another source is attached to an entry only by a declared identifier key (ChEMBL id; UniChem ChEMBL<->DrugBank/ChEBI/UNII; DGIdb chembl: concept ids; MATRIX drugbank_id/ChEBI)
merge_report.one_to_many_links_note: a DGIdb drug group, a MATRIX row or a UNII that matches several salt/stereoisomer entries is attached to each of them and flagged multiplicity>1; it is not collapsed
merge_report.possible_cross_source_duplicates: source-only entries (DGIdb, MATRIX, openFDA) that no identifier connects to a ChEMBL entry may describe the same substance as a ChEMBL entry; the entry count is an upper bound for distinct substances

dsld.bulk_list_coverage_note: the bulk probe was interrupted; names not probed have NO supplement evidence either way (unknown, not negative)
dsld.match_strength: name_only: DSLD labels carry no identifier; US labels only (not an Italian or EU classification)

not_obtained: dietary-supplement status for any compound that was not probed in DSLD, and for all probed ones except by normalised-name match (DSLD labels carry no identifiers)
non-US access (EMA, MHRA, PMDA, national lists): no open bulk source was found
US NDC products without a UNII (cannot be linked by identifier)
DGIdb newer than the 2024-06-10 TSV release

units.records_are: source-level substance records (a salt, a stereoisomer, a formulation record and a source-only row each count once); NOT distinct drugs and NOT distinct chemical entities
units.external_total_vs_acquired: the ChEMBL figure is the database's own declared total; it is not the number of records acquired, and the two are never added

chemical_families_reconciled.rule: ChEMBL records joined by parent/child hierarchy or by identical InChIKey first block (connectivity layer); reconciliation shown, nothing merged
chemical_families_reconciled.not_demonstrable_for: source-only records (no structure, no identifier tying them to a ChEMBL record); they are listed under possible_duplicates

possible_duplicates_and_unresolved_ident.meaning: the name coincidence is a flag for human review; identity is unresolved until an identifier says so

units.modality_unknown_meaning: source-only rows carry no molecule type; unknown is not small molecule

pharmacological_data.meaning: a target link is a source statement with action type and reference ids; it is not potency and not relevance to WWOX

units.evaluated_meaning: 0 until the WWOX needs matrix exists; no record in this catalogue has been scored or ranked for the disease
